name: Bluefors Oy
description: Bluefors is a world-leading manufacturer of ultra-low temperature measurement systems and cryogenic dilution refrigerators. The company provides critical cryogenic infrastructure for quantum computing systems, enabling quantum processors to operate at the near-absolute-zero temperatures required for quantum coherence. Bluefors systems are used by quantum computing companies and research institutions globally.
